answer: A practical defence is signed glazier registration with trade federation attestation. It rests on a registration the trade federation granted after assessed installations, which gives every honest agent a marble that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the jetty compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the quill is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
